node.label: Markets & indicators
node.summary: Sensex, Nifty, PMI and other quick indicators.

facts.text: **HSBC India Manufacturing PMI**: 54.7 in Oct (55.1 in Sept); export orders at a six-month high. A reading above 50 means expansion.
facts.plain: HSBC India Manufacturing PMI: 54.7 in Oct (55.1 in Sept); export orders at a six-month high. A reading above 50 means expansion.

facts.text: Sensex closed at **75,682.78** (+1,233) and Nifty 50 at **23,440** (+387.70), both up 1.7%. **Reliance** jumped 11.6% after Q2 FY27 results.

facts.text: Comex gold fell 7.26% in October to a one-year low of $3,884.9/ounce, while Comex silver dropped 19.1% to $49.13/ounce, as both precious metals posted negative returns for a second straight month.

facts.text: Foreign Portfolio Investors withdrew **₹34,843 crore** from Indian equities in October (second straight month of heavy outflows), per Central Depository Services data, amid concerns over crude oil prices and global interest rates.

facts.text: On 29 Oct the **Nifty** closed at **22,936.77** and the **Sensex** at **74,151.04**; the rupee touched **95.38/$** before closing at **95.26**.
